messages:
maria: Heads-up — marketing promo next Tue 09:00 UTC, expected ~3x qps for a 3-hour window. Goal: keep p99 <= 800ms. Can we confirm GPU-hour runway + admission plan?
alex: 3x is rough. What's current baseline p99 and reserved GPU counts?
maria: baseline p99 = 360ms, p95 = 180ms. avg steady requests/s = 120. reserved GPUs (eu-west1): 48 (v100 equiv).
cheng: quick back-of-envelope: assume avg tokens/request = 40, model throughput ~= 300 tok/s per GPU with our batching config -> ~7.5 req/s per GPU. 48 GPUs => ~360 req/s capacity. 3x qps => ~1080 req/s, so to avoid queueing you'd need ~144 GPUs. not feasible to instantly reserve.
alex: Agreed. Options: 1) soft-throttle/admit-control targeting p99 (start throttling non-SLA traffic above admit threshold), 2) prewarm burst pool (+40 GPUs) for the 3h window, 3) enable fallback to quantized model (~1.8-2x throughput) for best-effort traffic.
maria: cost check — cloud spot/burst GPUs estimate: 40 GPUs * 3h * $4.00/GPU-hr = $480 for the peak window. plus base reserved cost we already pay. worth comparing to expected revenue uplift.
cheng: admission curve proposal: admit rate = min(1, (target_service_capacity / observed_inflight)). Use queue depth hysteresis: only scale admit down after sustained queue > Q_high for 30s, and scale back up after queue < Q_low for 60s to avoid flapping. Q_high=1200, Q_low=800 as starting point.
rachel: I can run a quick queueing sim this afternoon. will test three scenarios: (A) no burst (48g), (B) +40 burst (88g), (C) +fallback model (effectively 1.9x throughput).
oncall-bot: Scheduled prewarm job created: `prewarm-eu-west1-2026-03-24-09:00-3h` by automation. details in #deployments.
rachel: Sim command I ran: `python sim_queue.py --arrival-rate 1080 --service-rate 7.5 --gpus 48 --duration 10800` -> results: projected p99 ~2200ms (unacceptable). With +40 GPUs (`--gpus 88`) -> p99 ~720ms. With fallback model (service_rate *1.9) -> p99 ~560ms.
alex: Good signal. So combo approach: enable admission control for best-effort, enable fallback model for burst traffic, prewarm a smaller burst pool (40 GPUs) to push p99 under 800ms. Also set alerting on admit rate and p99 regression.
maria: Please produce a short cost/risk matrix and an ops playbook: prewarm steps, rollout order (prewarm -> enable fallback -> soft-throttle), rollback plan. We'll review at ops sync 10:30.
cheng: I'll draft admit curve config and set the hysteresis timeouts. Will post PR for the admit controller config.
rachel: attaching sim csv to ticket #OPS-2897. I'll also run a sensitivity run on avg tokens/request +/-20% and post results by EOD.
maria: thanks team. If we can get PR + playbook by EOD we can sign-off with marketing. :thumbsup:
